summary: The AIR-ONE Emergency Response Coalition, formerly the Law Enforcement Aviation Coalition, supports agencies in Illinois that provide air support to law enforcement, emergency management, and fire/EMS. Its helicopters, known by the AIR-ONE call sign, serve agencies that would otherwise lack air support. The coalition is a volunteer-staffed 501(c)3 not-for-profit, and the Winthrop Harbor Police Department, as founding and coordinating agency, provides 24-hour dispatch for its helicopters.
one_line: AIR-ONE is a volunteer-run Illinois nonprofit coalition whose helicopters support law enforcement, emergency management, and fire/EMS agencies.
key_facts: The AIR-ONE Emergency Response Coalition was formerly named the Law Enforcement Aviation Coalition.
The coalition supports agencies that provide air support to law enforcement, emergency management and fire/EMS agencies in Illinois, United States.
Known by its "AIR-ONE" call sign, the helicopters are called upon by agencies that would otherwise not have air support capabilities available.
AIR-ONE is a not-for-profit, 501(c)3, charitable organization.
AIR-ONE is managed and staffed by volunteers from the aviation, law enforcement, emergency management and fire-rescue sectors.
The Winthrop Harbor (Illinois) Police Department is the founding and coordinating agency of AIR-ONE.
The Winthrop Harbor (Illinois) Police Department provides 24-hour dispatch services for all of the AIR-ONE helicopters.
